pending.scheduler-registro-br: created and configured (cron 0 */6 * * * UTC, region us-east4-eqdc4a) but intentionally NOT deployed and without variables: with fs storage the cron container would write the raw Registro.br artifact to an ephemeral disk, and the SHA-256 dedupe would then prevent it from ever being re-stored for that release list. Deploy after the bucket works.
